newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and they are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.

Traders said the rates were still under downward pressure today, with the market widely believing China's falling inflation would made the central bank consider more interest rate cuts after two earlier this year.

But, with heavy losses in late August, the room for further rises was limited, they said. "The rates have begun to stabilise in the past week," one trader said. "But there is still downward pressure in the market."
"Falling inflation and widespread losses by state-run firms have made investors believe the central bank might cut interest rates again to improve the state firms' performance," he said.
